articles.title: Gemini 4 Carbon
articles.summary: Google has introduced the Gemini 4 Carbon model, advancing AI capabilities with improved energy efficiency. This model enhances performance in natural language processing tasks while reducing carbon footprint, addressing sustainability concerns in AI development. Gemini 4 Carbon aims to set new industry standards for eco-friendly AI models.

articles.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe and Granary v2: Intelligent Multilingual Transcription You Can Prompt and Adapt
articles.summary: NVIDIA's Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe is an open-weight model for multilingual transcription, translation, speaker attribution, and audio Q&A. It's ranked first across several transcription and speaker attribution leaderboards, supporting up to 40 languages with low error rates. Granary v2 enhances this by offering reusable data pipelines and fine-tuning options, enabling customization for diverse vocabularies and specialized applications.

articles.title: Artificial Analysis v5 and the benchmarker's dilemma
articles.summary: Independent evaluation of language models is a hard task. It is difficult to create a number that is representative of current models that matches vibe checks, community sentiment, and scientific analysis, while being forward-looking enough so that it's not outdated in three months. Independent evaluators dictate the winners and losers of a trillion-dollar market. They can also influence the direction of model development, increasing the pressure.

articles.title: Qwenputer: a fully functioning, deterministic RISC-V CPU inside Qwen3.5
articles.summary: Qwenputer is a fully functioning, deterministic RISC-V CPU that runs inside Qwen3.5. The CPU runs on its own Gated DeltaNet layers as RAM. It can run arithmetic operations and C and MicroPython code without any external runtime or tool usage. This post explains how the model works, how the model uses GDN layers as RAM, and how the developer also slotted in an experimental in-model file storage.

articles.title: Building an Inference Stack That Improves Itself
articles.summary: Decagon's AutoResearch agents diagnose inference bottlenecks, test optimizations against production traffic replays, and preserve findings across experiments. The company reports throughput gains up to 2.5x within endpoint latency requirements through quantization, scheduling, engine patches, and speculative decoding, with production changes requiring human approval.

articles.title: Introducing the Microsoft Copilot harness: Unlocking the potential of truly multi-model agentic work
articles.summary: The Microsoft Copilot harness powers Copilot Code, Copilot Studio, the GitHub Copilot app, the CLI, VS Code, and more. It is now available through Microsoft Foundry. The harness gives developers and enterprise customers a fully managed way to build agents that reason, use tools, and complete complex, long-running tasks. It was built to perform across model families, and is flexible and configurable to any type of app, agent, or service.

articles.title: Introducing Vercel CI
articles.summary: The Vercel AI is now available in beta. The CI is able to keep up with coding agents. It runs only the tasks affected by a code change, and spins up only the compute those checks need. At Vercel, the system has decreased the time from git push to 'CI pass' by 2-6x.

articles.title: Route and orchestrate models with GitHub Copilot Fusion
articles.summary: GitHub Copilot Fusion lets Copilot intelligently route and orchestrate models for each task. It leverages the benefits of Project HydraFusion's multi-model orchestration and Copilot auto model selection's fine-tuned model selection to balance performance and cost efficiency. Copilot Fusion determines which models to use and how they work together depending on the level of effort selected by the user. Administrators can control which models Copilot Fusion can use and whether Copilot Fusion is the default.

articles.title: Meta has a new AI pet app called Waddle World
articles.summary: Meta launched Waddle World, a virtual AI pet app that functions like a Tamagotchi, in the Philippines on iOS and Android. Unlike traditional productivity tools or chatbots, it serves as a digital pet and personal journal, allowing users to interact and play mini-games without pressure. The app reflects Meta's cautious approach following legal issues faced by other AI companion apps.

articles.title: Anthropic just launched tools to show companies what their AI spending is buying
articles.summary: Anthropic has launched reporting tools to help companies measure and optimize their AI spending with its products like Claude Code. The tools offer detailed insights on productivity, costs, and recommendations, addressing a major concern for enterprise clients. Despite competition from models like OpenAI's Astra, Anthropic's strong enterprise presence and sticky workflows continue to drive significant adoption and spending growth.

articles.title: ElevenLabs Cue: Character-level audio timing
articles.summary: ElevenLabs' Cue is a forced alignment model for precise character-level timing in audio files.

articles.title: Build and manage Connected Apps in one place
articles.summary: Google has introduced a centralized platform for building and managing connected apps.

articles.title: Copilot Automations now learn from outcomes and self-improve
articles.summary: Copilot Automations now self-improve by learning from real-world outcomes on GitHub.

articles.title: Mirendil Introduces Lor for AI Research Automation
articles.summary: Lor is a system with agents that write code, run experiments, and iterate for days across hundreds of parallel workers.

articles.title: OpenAI now lets you text your Dot agent
articles.summary: OpenAI now allows US Pro users to text their Dot agents via iMessage and RCS, enabling instructions through text, photos, and voice memos.
